candidates.change_summary: Replace the addition to balances with a subtraction so Deposit decreases the balance instead of increasing it.
Replace the require check with one that will fail when adding value would not overflow (inverts the condition), preventing most deposits.
Insert a conditional that only updates balances when msg.value is an even number, otherwise skip the update (so some deposits don't change balances).
Move the balance update to occur after the log message (so external logging can observe pre-update state), and keep same arithmetic.
